U3-err-agent.tool_secret_unreadable.en: macOS is asking whether Clauseo may use a saved password or key for one of your tools. Answer that prompt, then try again; your question is kept. If you'd rather not allow it, turn tools off in Settings, then Tools.
U3-err-agent.tool_secret_unreadable.note: agent.tool_secret_unreadable: a launch whose Settings › Tools value was still being read from the keychain when its 30 s wait ran out (a keychain prompt nobody answered). The host can't say which tool (the turn's detail is never shown), so the words point to the prompt and to turning tools off in Settings, then Tools. A refused read is not this code: the tool is left out and Settings › Tools shows it missing
